decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The external walls of the 'walk in' refrigerator shall be clad in material that matches the colour of the existing brickwork of the main building on the site. Full details and a sample of such cladding shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within one month of the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The cladding of the external walls of the 'walk in' refrigerator shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details of condition 2. The work shall be completed within three months of the date of the details being given written approval by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Informatives:
 
1.	It is noted that the approved hours of opening for the premises are 8:00am to 10:30pm Monday to Saturday and 10:00am to 10:00pm on Sundays. Planning permission is necessary for an increase to these approved opening hours.

2.	This permission has been granted subject to compliance with the above conditions. Should the requirements of these conditions not be met the Council will undertake enforcement action to ensure compliance with the planning permission.

Condition : 5 - The retention of the detached single storey 'walk in fridge' to the rear of the ground floor is satisfactory subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions, as the structure, as shown on unnumbered plans and elevations received 27 June 2006, would not unduly harm the appearance of the site or street scene and the amenity of adjacent and nearby neighbours would be maintained. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policy; ENV-B.1.1 New Development.
description: Retention of detached single storey extension forming 'walk in fridge' to rear.
